Talent0_2Ability.name: Dog Chasing Cars
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: With a Melee Weapon, if unable to retaliate in combat, <buf ID=900008>[Pursuit]</buf> can be triggered, allowing the unit to move <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles toward the attacker after combat. If successful in reaching the target, use the melee weapon to cast <buf ID=900009>[Pursuit Retaliation]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> DMG.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Dog Chasing Cars
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
With a Melee Weapon, if unable to retaliate in combat, <buf ID=900008>[Pursuit]</buf> can be triggered, allowing the unit to move <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles toward the attacker after combat. If successful in reaching the target, use the melee weapon to cast <buf ID=900009>[Pursuit Retaliation]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> DMG.
If there are no allies within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-15%</color>.

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

700014.name: Perseverance
700014.SpecificEffects: After taking damage, grant <buf ID=7000142>[Bide]</buf> to self, up to <color=#F74848>3</color> stacks, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

700041.name: Morale Rise
700041.SpecificEffects: For every <color=#F74848>10%</color> reduction in self HP, DMG <color=#F74848>+3%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

700050.name: Time to Hunt
700050.describe: Gain <buf ID=7100901>[Movement UP]</buf> and <buf ID=7100303>[DMG UP II]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn. Can continue the action with the remaining movement.

100705.name: Last Stand
100705.SpecificEffects: When any part suffers overdamage, trigger <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf>, locking to <color=#F74848>1</color> HP, with a trigger interval of <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

100706.name: Bola Strike
100706.describe: Simultaneously uses 2 Melee Weapons to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>2*0.85x</color> DMG. When hitting the Body, inflicts <buf ID=7101505>[Crash]</buf> on the target after combat, lasting <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

100707.name: Desprate Beast
100707.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack in combat, for each enemy ST within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area, gain DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

100708.name: Ruthless Hunt
100708.describe: Uses Pile Bunker or Knuckles to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.7x</color> DMG. When hitting the Body, DMG <color=#F74848>+30%</color>.

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

100031.name: Alacrity 1
100031.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack with a Melee Weapon, there is a <color=#F74848>20%</color> chance to trigger <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> following the enemy’s attack, dealing <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> DMG.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

100034.name: Alacrity 2
100034.SpecificEffects: Before an Active Attack, the probability of triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> increases by <color=#F74848>6%</color> for each <color=#F74848>1</color> tile moved, up to <color=#F74848>30%</color>.

100035.name: Alacrity 3
100035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.75</color>.

100036.name: Alacrity 4
100036.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf>, prioritize hitting the part with the lowest HP.

100741.name: Rabid 1
100741.SpecificEffects: The movement distance of <buf ID=900008>[Pursuit]</buf> is increased to <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

100744.name: Rabid 2
100744.SpecificEffects: The damage multiplier for <buf ID=900009>[Pursuit Retaliation]</buf> is increased to <color=#F74848>0.85</color>.

100745.name: Rabid 3
100745.SpecificEffects: If a move to the attacker's side with <buf ID=900008>[Pursuit]</buf> fails, the system will automatically search for other targets within adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) area to cast <buf ID=900009>[Pursuit Retaliation]</buf>.

100746.name: Rabid 4
100746.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900009>[Pursuit Retaliation]</buf>, target the part with the lowest HP.
